Default parameters and arguments

Default parameters apply when an argument is omitted or undefined. Normal functions expose
arguments; arrows do not have their own arguments binding.

Interview question: Do defaults apply when null is passed?
Answer: No. Defaults apply only to undefined, including omitted arguments.
